Twist: Twist about the Y axis in radians per world unit of height: points rotate more the higher they are. 0 = none. Audio band2 adds to it.
Bend: Bends the mesh in the XY plane; rotation angle grows with X position (radians per world unit). 0 = none. Audio band1 adds to it.
Inflate: Pushes points along their normals (breathing), by half this value in world units. Negative shrinks. Audio band1 adds to it.
Noiseshell: Strength of the noise displacement along normals, in world units. 0 = off. Audio band4 adds to it.
Noisefreq: Spatial frequency of the noise shell. Higher = finer, busier bumps; lower = broad lumps.
Ripple: Amplitude of concentric ripples travelling out from the top pole (0,1,0); fades with distance. 0 = off. Audio band3 adds to it.
Ripplefreq: Ripple spatial frequency (waves per world unit, roughly). Higher = tighter rings.
Ripplecycles: Whole ripple cycles per animation loop. Integer so the motion loops seamlessly; higher = faster ripples.
Noisecycles: Whole trips the noise makes through noise space per animation loop. Integer so it loops seamlessly; higher = faster-changing noise.
Modgain: Gain applied to the in2 audio bands (band1..band4) before they are added to the amounts. 0 = ignore audio.
Resolution: Preview TOP size in pixels. Only affects the node viewer preview.
Demoshape: Mesh used when in1 is unconnected. sphere: UV sphere. torus: donut.
Detail: Demo mesh density (subdivisions). Higher = smoother, heavier. Only used with the demo shape.
Roughness: Preview material roughness, 0 = mirror-like, 1 = fully diffuse.
Envintensity: Brightness of the preview's softbox environment lighting and reflections. 0 = none.
Redaccent: Strength of the red rim light in the preview. 0 = off.
Keyintensity: Brightness of the preview's key light. 0 = off.
Camdist: Preview camera distance from the origin in world units.
Camheight: Preview camera height above the origin in world units.
Orbitturns: Whole camera orbits per animation loop in the preview. Integer so it loops seamlessly; 0 = static camera.
Fov: Preview camera field of view in degrees. Lower = more telephoto.
